claims.claim: Every theme's ink on its ground measures 11:1 or better.
claims.basis: Computed by scripts/build_derived.py with the WCAG 2.x relative-luminance formula; listed on the contrast reference page and gated by the validator.

claims.claim: All 48 font families the reel and figures use are licensed SIL OFL 1.1 or Apache 2.0.
claims.basis: License field of each @fontsource package manifest, recorded in canon/fonts.json on 2026-11-10.

claims.claim: The built reel is one self-contained HTML file that requests nothing from the network.
claims.basis: The validator scans reel/dist for src, href and url() references to http or https; only plain anchor links are allowed.

claims.claim: Every S4 data beat in the reel runs 9.5 seconds, and every loop runs 21 to 26.3 seconds.
claims.basis: Parsed from the beats arrays in reel/src/scenes-*.js by the build and checked by a regression test.

claims.claim: The reel exposes one global Pause control and per-plate beat chips; motion plays on load.
Under 26 ms average frame time the reel holds full render scale; above it the scale steps down to a 50% floor.
Content must not flash more than three times in any one-second period.
claims.basis: W3C WCAG 2.2, Success Criterion 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold.

claims.claim: Moving content that starts automatically and lasts more than five seconds needs a way to pause, stop or hide it.
claims.basis: W3C WCAG 2.2, Success Criterion 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide.

claims.claim: PEAT is a free photosensitive epilepsy analysis tool from the Trace Research and Development Center.
B612 was drawn for legibility on aircraft cockpit screens.
A visual style cannot be owned, while logos, characters and specific creative expression can.
claims.basis: The working position behind the Homage Rule. It is a design rule, not legal advice; escalate any licensed-look request.

claims.claim: Composition- and rhythm-led themes (family E) survive the Boardroom dial better than glitch-led ones (family B).
claims.basis: Read from the B2B fit column: three of five family E themes run at Boardroom as is, against one of four in family B.
